LANDING.trust_card3_title: Kandidati mqiegħda madwar l-Ewropa, UK, Kanada u Awstralja
LANDING.trust_card3_desc: It-team tagħna għandha rekordu ta' piazzamenti internazzjonali ta' suċċess bi sponsoranza ta' visa — riżultati ġenwini, nies ġenwini.
LANDING.features_sub: Għodod qawwali għal kandidati u reklutaġġin, l-kollox fi post wieħed.
LANDING.why_us_title: Għaliex NTL Career Nexus hija Differenti
LANDING.hiw_sub: Reġistra darba u ħalli t-team tagħna jaħdmu l-qaħqah – minn bini tal-profil għal introduzzjonijiet ta' impjegħ.

FEATURES.f1_desc: Aħna personalment naqbel il-profil tiegħek ma' employers li jkollu liċenzja valida tal-sponsor fl-Ewropa, UK, Kanada u Awstralja.
FEATURES.f2_desc: It-tim tiegħna ibnu l-profil professjonali tiegħek u jirriċ ic-CV tiegħek fil-format korrett għall-pajjiż ta' mira tiegħek.
FEATURES.f2_chip1: Format ta' CV UK u Ewropew
FEATURES.f2_chip3: Format ta' CV Gulf u Asjan
FEATURES.f3_desc: Aħna ngħiduk permezz ta' kull pass — dokumenti meħtieġa, proċess tal-visa, preparazzjoni tal-intervista.
FEATURES.f4_desc: Kull kandidat fuq il-pjattaforma tiegħna ġie personalment vverifikat mit-tim tiegħna.
FEATURES.f5_desc: Filtra b'nazzjonalità, settur, esperjenza, pajjiż ta' mira, livell ta' Ingliż u aktar.
FEATURES.f6_desc: Sib il-kandidat tajjeb? It-tim tiegħna personalment jiffaċilita l-introduzzjoni.

WHY.w1_desc: Mhux bord tal-impjieg pubbliku. Kull kandidat u recruiter ġie personalment approvat.
WHY.w2_desc: It-tim tiegħna personalment jaqbel u jibgħat il-profil tiegħek lil employer tajjeb.
WHY.w3_desc: Kull opportunità fuq il-pjattaforma tiegħna hija reali, legali, u vverifikat.

STEPS.candidate1_desc: Admins jirriċu l-profil tiegħek u jagħtu aċċess għall-pjattaforma.
STEPS.candidate2_desc: It-tim tiegħna personalment jirrevedi l-isfond tiegħek u jaqbel ma' employers.
STEPS.candidate3_desc: Aħna jibgħatu l-profil tiegħek direttament lil employers imqiegħdin.
STEPS.recruiter1_desc: Admins jirriċu l-profil recruiter tiegħek u jagħtu aċċess għall-talent pool.
STEPS.recruiter2_desc: Uża filters qawwija biex issib kandidati li jaqblu mal-rekwiżiti tiegħek.
STEPS.recruiter3_desc: Itlob informazzjoniet tal-kontatt għall-kandidati top tiegħek.

TESTIMONIALS.t1_quote: NTL Career Nexus magħmula l-ħjiga tal-irwol frontend tassew sempliċi. Fi żewġ ġimgħat kelli tliet mistoħbiet ta' intervista minn kumpaniji li tassew ridt naħdem għalihom.
TESTIMONIALS.t2_quote: Is-sistema ta' mistoħba tal-kuntatt hija brillanti. Kandidati jħossuh sigur u jien nink aċċess verifikat mingħajr frizzjoni. L-aħjar għodda ta' ħdura li uża din is-sena.
TESTIMONIALS.t3_quote: Kont skeptiku dwar pjattaforma ta' impjieg oħra, imma s-sistema tal-profil ta' NTL Career Nexus hija tassew dettaljata. Reklutaġġin setgħu jaraw il-sett sħiħ tal-għarfien tiegħek mingħajr back-and-forth.
TESTIMONIALS.t4_quote: Mgħarraf tal-pipeline tal-ħdura tagħna permezz ta' NTL Career Nexus qassimha l-ħin tal-istqarr tiegħna bin-nofs. Il-lista mqarrba u l-workflow tal-kuntatt huma eżatt dak li kienu bżonjin.

COOKIE_CONSENT.title: We use cookies
COOKIE_CONSENT.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences, and improve your experience. Essential and authentication cookies are always active — they are required for the application to work. You can customise which optional cookies you allow.

COOKIE_PREFERENCES.title: Cookie Preferences
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.subtitle: Manage how this application uses cookies and local storage on your device.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.essential_desc: Required for the application to function. Includes CSRF protection, secure routing, and core session management.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.essential_examples: Internal routing state. No personally identifiable data.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.authentication_desc: Keeps you signed in across page loads. The refresh token is stored in an HttpOnly cookie (server-managed, inaccessible to JavaScript). The access token is held in localStorage and expires automatically.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.authentication_examples: HttpOnly refresh token cookie (7-day expiry, Secure + SameSite=Strict in production). Access token in localStorage (2-hour expiry).
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.analytics_desc: Analytics cookies help website owners understand how visitors interact with websites by collecting and reporting information anonymously.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.analytics_examples: Page views, feature usage, error rates. No personally identifiable data.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.marketing_desc: Marketing cookies are used to track visitors across websites. The intention is to display ads that are relevant and engaging for the individual user.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.marketing_examples: Ad personalisation, conversion tracking. Not currently in use.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.preferences_note: Your preferences are stored locally on your device and will be remembered for 12 months. You can update them at any time from the Manage Cookies link in the page footer.
